metadata.name: Stream Search
metadata.description: Soft streams of colour pour out of the dark into a frosted glass search field and leave as one clean beam that answers every keystroke. A real input with value, onChange and onSubmit, drawn in one WebGL pass. More like this, plus a designer your coding agent can use, at studios.lou15.com/?ref=21st
